L14:   1. cite2†Animal Control L15: 
L16: Key services for Animal Control include handling strays, neighborhood nuisance animals, injured animals, and rabies concerns.
L17: 
L18:   2. cite3†Assessor's Office L19: 
L20: The Assessors' Office is responsible for the administration of all laws and regulations regarding property tax assessment.
L21: 
L22:   3. cite4†Cemetery L23: The Cemetery/Shade Tree/Open Space Department is comprised of a Tree Warden/City Arborist, one General Foreman, one Administrative Assistant, Laborers, and seasonal workers, and is part of Public Services.
L24: 
L25:   4. cite5†City Clerk & Elections L26: Visitors to this website will have the ability to access information regarding the numerous functions of the City Clerk’s Office, including vital records, elections, voting, and general historical information pertaining to the City of Salem, City Hall, and the Council Chamber.
L27: 
L28:   5. cite6†City Electrician L29: The Mission of Salem Electrical Department, is the management, maintenance, repair, and security of the City's Streetlights, decorative lights, park and public building lights. The aluminum cobra head pole & lights are maintained by National Grid. The traffic signals and controllers, fire alarm street boxes and cables, are also the responsibility of the department's signal maintainers.
L30: 
L31:   6. cite7†City Engineer L32: In addition to providing engineering support and services to the City of Salem, the City Engineer provides oversight of the Water and Sewer Department as well as the Recycling and Trash Department.
L33: 
L34:   7. cite8†Collector's Office L35: 
L36: The Collectors Office is responsible for collecting monies due to the city including but not limited to Real Estate Tax, Personal Property Tax, Motor Vehicle Excise Tax, Boat Excise Tax, Parking Ticket Fines, Water/Sewer Bills, and Trash Bills.
L37: 
L38:   8. cite9†Council on Aging Department L39: The Salem Council on Aging was founded in October of 1967 to serve the needs of Salem's aging community.
L40: 
L41:   9. cite10†Diversity, Equity & Inclusion (DEI) L42: 
L43: The City of Salem strives to proactively address and dismantle systemic barriers that perpetuate inequity in society.
L44: 
L45:   10. cite11†Donations L46: 
L47: Easily donate to various Salem funds.
L48: 
L49:   11. cite12†Emergency Management L50: 
L51: Through use of the Comprehensive Emergency Management Plan, the coordination of the various city departments is accomplished during emergencies.
L52:   12. cite13†Finance Department L53: 
L54: The Finance Department is responsible for maintaining and administering a financial accounting and management information system that provides accurate, complete, and timely information pertaining to all financial activities of city departments, agencies, commissions, and authorities.
L55: 
L56:   13. cite14†Fire Department L57: 
L58: See information on the Salem Fire Department and Emergency Management.
L59: 
L60:   14. cite15†GIS & Maps L61: Our mission is to provide municipal employees, departments, committees, councils, boards, and the general public with geospatial products, support, and insights.
L62:
